scenarios.title: Clean invoice
scenarios.story: Everything adds up and no approval is needed.

scenarios.title: Approved by the right person
scenarios.story: Above DKK 20,000 and approved by a manager — exactly what policy requires.

scenarios.title: Missing approval
scenarios.story: Above DKK 20,000 but nobody approved it.

scenarios.title: Approved at too low a level
scenarios.story: Above DKK 100,000 needs a director; only a manager approved.

scenarios.title: Wrong VAT amount
scenarios.story: The VAT line does not match 25% of the subtotal, so the total is wrong too.

scenarios.title: Line total does not add up
scenarios.story: One line's quantity × unit price is wrong; the error cascades to subtotal, VAT and total.

scenarios.title: Non-standard VAT rate
scenarios.story: A domestic supplier charged 12% instead of the standard 25%.

scenarios.title: Foreign supplier
scenarios.story: A German supplier with 0% VAT needs a manual VAT (reverse-charge) review.

scenarios.title: Invoice in euros
scenarios.story: Not in DKK, so approval thresholds cannot be evaluated automatically.

scenarios.title: Missing information
scenarios.story: No issue date or subtotal, and a line without price or total — so the approval threshold cannot be checked.
